name: hyrule_field
label: Hyrule Field
about: Pieces and textures cut from Hyrule Field (spot00). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09). `ground` is the field's grass (a plain camo at about 960 a repeat, no detail texture), `riverbank` the sloping banks of the river and the moat, `cliff` the grassy cliffs round the field (a grass lip top and bottom, cut out at the top), `cliff_b` the rockier walls of the terraces, `rock`, `rock_b` to `_d` and `dirt` the Gerudo Valley approach. Round Castle Town: `town_wall` the white walls, `tower_front` and `tower_stone` the gate's towers, `crest` the royal crest over the gate, `brick_dark` the moat's walls, `moat_floor` its bed, `stone_wall` the stone retaining walls. `fence` (white rails), `picket` (iron pickets) and `barbed_post` are fence cards; `dirt_path` and its variants are the translucent path decals (white, tinted by the scene); `backdrop_*` are the far cards (Death Mountain, the castle, the town).

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: hf_market_gate
pieces.label: Castle Town gate (exit)
pieces.about: The gatehouse into Castle Town: two white towers 620 tall either side of a passage 360 wide, the royal crest over it and the drawbridge's chain anchors on the towers' faces (the drawbridge itself is an actor). Set into a town wall: its outer sides are the wall's. The origin is the passage's foot on the towers' face; the exit floor (exit 8) starts 100 in. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hf_stone_bridge
pieces.label: Stone footbridge
pieces.about: A low stone footbridge with balustrades over the river east of the moat, 250 long and 200 wide between its rails. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hf_gate_post
pieces.label: Stone gate post
pieces.about: A square stone post 200 tall with a cap: a pair of them flank the way to Lake Hylia.

pieces.name: hf_stone_wall
pieces.label: Low stone wall
pieces.about: A stone wall 600 long, 40 thick and 232 tall with a capped top, from beside Lon Lon Ranch.

pieces.name: hf_tree_stump
pieces.label: Gnarled stump
pieces.about: A broad old trunk 300 tall with spreading roots, by the way to the Lost Woods.

pieces.name: hf_banner_pole
pieces.label: Banner pole
pieces.about: A lattice pole 400 tall with a string of pennants, at the gate of Lon Lon Ranch.

pieces.name: hf_ladder
pieces.label: Ladder
pieces.about: A wooden ladder 210 tall up the terraces on the way to Lake Hylia (wall types ladder and ladder_top). Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hf_waterfall
pieces.label: Waterfall
pieces.about: The moat's overflow falling 315 into the river. Translucent; no collision.

pieces.name: hf_window
pieces.label: Arrow slit
pieces.about: A narrow stone-framed window, drawn on the town wall beside the gate. Flat: no collision.
